Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

a: A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: When one of my Digimon digivolves into [Barbamon (X Antibody)], in what order can I activate this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect and the effects that trigger upon digivolution into that Digimon?

Effect: [Trash] [Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into [Barbamon (X Antibody)], by returning this card to the bottom of the deck, activate this card's [Main] effects.

[Main] If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's level 7 or lower Digimon. For every 3 cards in their hand, remove 1 from this effect's level maximum.
